models.name: whole-body PBPK model of ICG
models.notes:
Whole-body PBPK model of ICG

Description

Model for whole-body distribution and elimination of indocyanine green encoded in SBML format.

Assumptions:

  • icg is only metabolized in the liver

<assignmentRule variable="QC">
  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:sbml="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version1/core">
    <apply>
      <times/>
      <apply>
        <divide/>
        <ci> CO </ci>
        <cn sbml:units="ml_per_l" type="integer"> 1000 </cn>
      </apply>
      <cn sbml:units="s_per_min" type="integer"> 60 </cn>
    </apply>
  </math>
</assignmentRule>

<assignmentRule variable="Vli">
  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:sbml="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version1/core">
    <apply>
      <times/>
      <ci> BW </ci>
      <ci> FVli </ci>
      <apply>
        <minus/>
        <cn sbml:units="dimensionless" type="integer"> 1 </cn>
        <ci> resection_rate </ci>
      </apply>
    </apply>
  </math>
</assignmentRule>

<assignmentRule variable="Vve">
  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:sbml="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version1/core">
    <apply>
      <times/>
      <apply>
        <minus/>
        <cn sbml:units="dimensionless" type="integer"> 1 </cn>
        <ci> HCT </ci>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <minus/>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <ci> BW </ci>
          <ci> FVve </ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <times/>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci> FVve </ci>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci> FVar </ci>
              <ci> FVve </ci>
              <ci> FVpo </ci>
              <ci> FVhv </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
          <ci> BW </ci>
          <ci> Fblood </ci>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <cn sbml:units="l_per_kg" type="integer"> 1 </cn>
            <apply>
              <plus/>
              <ci> FVar </ci>
              <ci> FVve </ci>
              <ci> FVpo </ci>
              <ci> FVhv </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
    </apply>
  </math>
</assignmentRule>

math.formula: (1 dimensionless - HCT) * (BW * FVve - (FVve / (FVar + FVve + FVpo + FVhv)) * BW * Fblood * (1 l_per_kg - (FVar + FVve + FVpo + FVhv)))
